newsitem.title: USA: Dorchester Cty, S.C., approves $15 mln school GOs.
newsitem.headline: Dorchester Cty, S.C., approves $15 mln school GOs.

text.p: Voters in Dorchester County, S.C., School District 4 have approved a $15 million general obligation bond issue, a school spokeswoman said Tuesday.

The issue, approved in a special election on Monday, will not require a property tax increase. Bond proceeds will be used to build a new consolidated school for students who now attend Saint George and Harleyville-Ridgeville high schools, and to renovate the latter into a consolidated elementary school to replace Clay Hill and Jenkins Hill elementary schools.

Debt service would be paid primarily from savings generated by consolidating the schools. Under the new plan the district will run four schools instead of six, saving $700,000 a year in operating costs.
Voters in the district rejected previous bond proposals in 1992 and 1994.
